close_reason: Design-validated: review confirmed the existing shape is correct. No code change required. Closing to reduce backlog noise; the docstring + test coverage already document the invariant.
description: src/client.rs:419-525 + src/client.rs:592-621 — the SSE state machine decodes UTF-8 incrementally because reqwest's bytes_stream() emits HTTP chunks at network-layer boundaries that can split a multi-byte UTF-8 codepoint. A naive .map(|b| String::from_utf8_lossy(&b)) would corrupt every multibyte char straddling a chunk boundary into a U+FFFD replacement. The raw_buf retain-incomplete-head + valid_up_to drain is the correct shape. The 3-byte scan_from overlap is calibrated to the longest delimiter prefix that can be incomplete. Test coverage at src/client.rs:712-748 documents the exact scenarios. Defend this against any 'just decode each chunk with from_utf8_lossy' suggestion.
title: SSE raw_buf + decode_utf8_chunk split-sequence handling is necessary, not optional
